title: Echoes of the Shattered Throne
brief: Original-IP crpg-tactical game (sub-genre: crpg-tactical). Capture the core mechanics and game-feel of "Baldur's Gate 3" (critically acclaimed, 96%) — but with your OWN original name, theme, characters and art. Do NOT reference or reuse that title's IP. SIGNATURE MECHANIC for this genre: . MUST SHIP COMPLETE: a working menu (title + difficulty + how-to + settings via FFG.Shell), the page control bar (fullscreen/mute/pause), a clear win AND lose state, readable HUD, and polished feel — it must play start-to-finish with no manual fixes.

M0.done_when: design doc written: core loop, verbs, scope, art direction, definition_of_done

M1.done_when: core loop genuinely playable in ONE level: structure+feel green, no crash

M2.done_when: every verb in the design doc implemented and survives the play-bot

M3.done_when: multiple levels + progression + a real difficulty curve; everything reachable

M4.done_when: menu + audio + game-feel/juice; vision fidelity high; zero crashes

M5.done_when: deep QA: structure+feel+fidelity+review all green across repeated playthroughs

design_doc.title: Echoes of the Shattered Throne
design_doc.core_loop: Players command a party of four outcasts fleeing a collapsing theocracy, navigating procedurally-branched story encounters that resolve through dialogue skill-checks OR turn-based tactical combat on a hex grid. Every choiceâ€”who you recruit, which faction you betray, which gods you defyâ€”permanently alters the world state and unlocks different tactical abilities. Combat rewards positioning, environmental interactions (ignite oil, collapse scaffolding, shove enemies off cliffs), and synergistic party combos; dialogue rewards building a coherent ideological stance (militant, diplomatic, or nihilistic) that gates late-game alliances. The loop is: explore branching node â†’ make choice (talk/fight/stealth) â†’ gain resources/story flags â†’ upgrade party â†’ face consequences in next node.

in: 4-character party with fixed archetypes (Knight, Apostate, Thief, Branded)
12-node branching campaign (3 acts Ã— 4 nodes) with 2-3 story branches per act
Turn-based hex-grid combat (12Ã—8 tiles, elevation, destructible objects)
Dialogue skill-checks using Strength/Cunning/Faith stats (d20 roll + modifier vs DC)
5 equipment slots per character (weapon, armor, accessory, consumable Ã—2)
Environmental hazards (fire, poison clouds, collapsing terrain, chasms)
Faction reputation system (Monarchists/Reformers/Cultists) affecting available quests and shop inventory
Camp rest system: restore HP, swap gear, trigger companion story vignettes
Win condition: reach final node with any faction alliance and defeat final boss
Lose condition: full party wipe OR three consecutive failed critical plot checks
HUD: party portraits + HP/AP bars, turn order tracker, skill hotbar, objective text
FFG.Shell integration: title screen, difficulty (Story/Balanced/Ruthless), how-to-play, audio/visual settings
Page controls: fullscreen toggle, mute, pause (combat only)
out: Custom character creation (fixed party of four)
Procedural loot (fixed loot tables per node)
Stealth as a full mechanic (reduced to single skill-check option in dialogue)
Permadeath (party wipe restarts from last node checkpoint)

art_direction.palette: Desaturated golds, burnt umbers, charcoal grays, and sickly greensâ€”evoking decaying grandeur. Accent color: electric cyan for divine/magic effects.
art_direction.mood: Grim Renaissance meets collapsing theocracy. Crumbling cathedrals, tattered banners, iconoclastic graffiti. Hand-painted token art for characters (think Darkest Dungeon meets Disco Elysium). Hex tiles use simple geometric shapes with painted textures (stone, wood, fire, water). UI is parchment-textured with ink-splatter borders. Combat VFX: minimal particle bursts (sparks, blood droplets, spell glyphs) to keep readability high.

milestone_plan.M1: Vertical Slice â€” Single combat encounter (4v4) on a hex map with elevation, one environmental hazard (fire), and three skills per character. Win = enemies dead, lose = party dead. HUD shows HP/AP, turn order, and one objective. Title screen + difficulty select functional.
milestone_plan.M2: Core Loop â€” 3-node story chain: dialogue â†’ combat â†’ camp. Dialogue has two skill-check options (succeed/fail branches story). Combat encounter uses loot drops to equip new gear. Camp allows rest + one companion vignette. Faction reputation tracks one choice (Monarchist vs Reformer).
milestone_plan.M3: Full Campaign â€” All 12 nodes playable with branching (3 major forks, 2 endings). All four characters have unique skill trees (6 abilities each). Five enemy archetypes (Soldier, Zealot, Beast, Sorcerer, Elite). Boss fight with two phases. All equipment slots functional (20 unique items).
milestone_plan.M4: Polish Pass â€” Animated sprite idles + hit reactions. Combat VFX for all 24 abilities. SFX for UI clicks, dice rolls, hits, environmental destruction. Ambient music track + combat track. Tutorial tooltips for first combat. Objective tracker updates per node. Balance pass: no encounter winnable without tactics.
milestone_plan.M5: Ship â€” All FFG.Shell requirements met (how-to-play screen, settings persist). Page controls (fullscreen/mute/pause) tested. Two full playthroughs QA'd (one per major branch). Definition-of-done checklist verified. Build deployed, no manual patches required.

definition_of_done: Player can complete full campaign from title screen to victory screen in 90-120 minutes without manual intervention
Both win conditions (Monarchist ending + Reformer ending) are reachable and trigger distinct victory text
Lose condition (party wipe) triggers game-over screen with retry option returning to last node checkpoint
All 12 nodes have at least one dialogue skill-check that branches story outcome
Every combat encounter (8 total) requires tactical positioning to win on Balanced difficultyâ€”no single strategy dominates all fights
HUD displays party HP/AP, turn order, active character, and current objective at all times during combat
All four characters have six unlockable abilities each, with clear tooltips explaining damage/range/cost
Faction reputation system correctly gates at least three dialogue options and two shop inventory changes
Camp rest restores full party HP and triggers at least four unique companion vignettes across campaign
Environmental hazards (fire, collapsing floor, chasms) are present in at least four combat maps and affect AI pathfinding
FFG.Shell integration complete: title screen, difficulty selector (affects enemy HP/damage by 25%), how-to-play with control scheme, audio/visual settings that persist across sessions
Page controls functional: fullscreen toggle, mute (affects music + SFX independently), pause (freezes combat, not dialogue)
No placeholder art: all characters, enemies, and tiles use final painted assets
No debug text or console logs visible in shipped build
Build runs at 60fps on mid-tier hardware (tested: integrated GPU, 8GB RAM) with no crash bugs in two full playthroughs
